title: get_admin_status input
description: Run the product: the host settings that are safe to show (environment, demo, step-up sign-in, the daily refresh, the store and its schema version), the configuration in force, the Tool Policy as a list, the sanctioned clients and what each did recently, the reminders and notices the daily refresh sent, the approval outbox, and the run-now action of the refresh. The platform admin, the configuration admin and the auditor read it; only the platform admin and the auditor see the notices listed.

days.description: The window for recent client calls and notices.

includeToolPolicy.description: False leaves the Tool Policy rows out.
